title: Add a New Member
callout: CSV import for bulk roster upload

shots.say: New member joining the department? Adding them takes about a minute.
shots.caption: Adding a new member

shots.say: On the Members page, tap Add.
shots.caption: Members → Add

shots.say: Fill in their name, address, phone and email. Leave the membership number blank if your department numbers members automatically.
shots.caption: Name, address, phone, email

shots.say: Leave Set initial password unchecked, and they're emailed a temporary password. If email isn't set up, set one here and hand it to them.
shots.caption: Unchecked = temporary password by email

shots.say: Membership status starts at Probationary for a new joiner. Pick their rank, and a position if they hold one.
shots.caption: Probationary by default · pick a rank

shots.say: Tap Save Member, and the new member is on the roster.
shots.caption: Save Member

shots.say: Adding twenty or fifty members at once? Use Import instead. Only first name, last name and email are required.
shots.caption: Bulk? Import a CSV

shots.say: New member, added in a minute.
shots.caption: New member, added in a minute
